portfolio.title: Fancy Auth Form

portfolio.description: Many complex components were implemented in the project: credit calculators, multi-stage mortgage application forms, asynchronous filter of bank services, custom maps (REST API YandexMap) with ATMs and office points.

workExperience.title: Ramax Holding (Integro Technologies)
workExperience.description: Led large-scale migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3 + TypeScript with full architectural redesign of high-load systems. Engineered performance optimization achieving 50% LCP reduction through code-splitting and tree-shaking. Handled real-time data processing with 10k+ rows via WebSocket (AG-Grid), implemented microservices architecture for independent module deployment (airport control hub, fintech dashboard).

workExperience.title: Volga-Dnepr
workExperience.description: Lead project: developed flight visualization system with custom Canvas rendering engine (Fabric.js). Solved predictive collision detection for dispatch operations achieving 40% render acceleration. Architected critical performance-sensitive real-time application. Responsible for tech stack selection and architectural decisions for mission-critical systems.

workExperience.title: Open School LLC
workExperience.description: Comprehensive platform overhaul: codebase architecture redesign, UX improvements, stability enhancement through legacy code refactoring (80% downtime reduction). Developed navigation crawler for dynamic menu generation. Localization for Russian market, full backend integration (Node.js, Express, MongoDB). Transformed educational platform into production-ready system.

workExperience.title: Digital Forge
workExperience.description: Full-cycle delivery of 50+ commercial projects: landing pages, corporate portals, promotional sites, e-commerce platforms. Created reusable component architecture (Web Components + Vue 2) accelerating time-to-market. Implemented best practices: lazy loading, service workers, Lighthouse optimization (90+), payment gateway integrations (Stripe, CloudPayments), analytics (GTM, Yandex.Metrica). 100% cross-browser support (IE11+).

workExperience.title: Freelance & Outsourcing
workExperience.description: Diverse fullstack solutions: SPA, SSR, PWA applications using Canvas for graphics and WebSocket for real-time data. Multi-stack expertise (Vue, Node.js, PHP, MongoDB, PostgreSQL). Both team and solo experience. Built scalable, performance-focused applications maintaining high code quality standards.
